{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW Slated for Upgrades.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Purah]] |location= Hateno Ancient Tech Lab |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW| * Remote Bomb + * Sheikah Sensor + * Stasis + }} |previous= "{{Color BotW|Main Quest|[[Locked Mementos]]}}" |next= "{{Color BotW|Side Quest|[[Sunshroom Sensing]]}}" }} "{{Term/Store|Slated for Upgrades||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|Slated for Upgrades}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Hateno Ancient Tech Lab}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== During the "[[Locked Mementos]]" [[Main Quest]], [[Purah]] will ask [[Link]] to gather some [[Ancient Material]]s for her after he sees [[Impa]].{{Cite|You don't have to worry about this until after you see Impa, but I want you to bring me back some {{Color BotW|Red|ancient materials}}!|Purah|BotW}} She says he can deliver them to either her or [[Robbie]] and promises him "something good" in return.{{Cite|Bring them either to {{Color BotW|Red|me}} or to {{Color BotW|Red|Robbie}} at the {{Color BotW|Red|Akkala Ancient Tech Lab}}. As if my joy weren't enough, if you bring us {{Color BotW|Red|ancient materials}}, we'll give you {{Color BotW|Red|something good}} as a reward.|Purah|BotW}} This begins the [[Side Quest]]. When Link speaks to Purah again for more information,{{Cite|[Something good?] Aha! I'm glad you asked!|Purah|BotW}} she explains that in exchange for Ancient Materials, she will power up the [[Rune]]s on his [[Sheikah Slate]].{{Cite|If you bring me some {{Color BotW|Red|ancient materials}}, I'll {{Color BotW|Red|power up}} your {{Color BotW|Blue|runes}}!|Purah|BotW}} The prices are as follows: {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:60%; max-width:60em;" |- !style="width:30%"| Rune !style="width:30%"| Cost |- |[[Sheikah Sensor]] |3 [[Ancient Screw]]s{{Cite|You'll need {{Color BotW|Red|three ancient screws}} to power up your {{Color BotW|Blue|Sheikah Sensor}}.|Purah|BotW}} |- |[[Remote Bomb]]s |3 [[Ancient Shaft]]s{{Cite|You'll need {{Color BotW|Red|three ancient shafts}} to power up your {{Color BotW|Blue|Remote Bombs}}.|Purah|BotW}} |- |[[Stasis]] |3 [[Ancient Core]]s{{Cite|You'll need {{Color BotW|Red|three ancient cores}} to power up {{Color BotW|Blue|Stasis}}.|Purah|BotW}} |} Once Link returns to the [[Hateno Ancient Tech Lab]], Purah asks him if he has the ancient Materials.{{Cite|Did you bring me any {{Color BotW|Red|ancient materials}}?|Purah|BotW}} When he confirms that he does, Purah will allow him to power up one of his Runes.{{Cite|[Ancient materials!] Now then, in exchange for those {{Color BotW|Red|ancient materials}}... I'll {{Color BotW|Red|power up}} a {{Color BotW|Blue|rune}} on your {{Color BotW|Blue|Sheikah Slate}}!|Purah|BotW}}{{Note|Though Purah suggests going to see Impa first, she will still upgrade Link's Runes if he has the Materials.{{Cite|I think you should go see Impa first. But if you're saying you already have some {{Color BotW|Red|ancient materials}}... Then why don't we go ahead and {{Color BotW|Red|power up}} your {{Color BotW|Blue|Sheikah Slate}}?|Purah|BotW}}}} If Link agrees, Purah asks him to choose which one he wants to upgrade.{{Cite|[I'm game.] So... Which {{Color BotW|Red|rune}} do you want to power up?|Purah|BotW}} She will remove the lock on the [[Guidance Stone]],{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Blue|Guidance Stone}} lock removed!|Purah|BotW}} which will then enhance his Runes.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Sheikah Slate authenticated. Enhancing Sheikah Sensor.}}|Guidance Stone|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Sheikah Slate authenticated. Enhancing Remote Bomb rune.}}|Guidance Stone|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Sheikah Slate authenticated. Enhancing Stasis rune.}}|Guidance Stone|BotW}} After all of the Runes have been upgraded,{{Cite|Hm? What's this? Perhaps you already went and powered them all up?!|Purah|BotW}} Purah will state that, with Link's Sheikah Slate and swordsmanship, there is nothing to fear.{{Cite|Well, I suppose with your {{Color BotW|Blue|Sheikah Slate}} and your legendary swordsmanship, we have nothing to fear.|Purah|BotW}} She believes that he will now be able to defeat [[Calamity Ganon]],{{Cite|Yes, quite! Nothing at all! Not even... {{Color BotW|Red|Calamity Ganon}}!|Purah|BotW}} and the Side Quest will be completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | Purah has offered to help you out in exchange for some {{Color BotW|Red|ancient components}}.

Just what are these ancient components? And who is {{Color BotW|Red|Robbie}}? You'll have to ask Purah for the answers. |- | 2 | If you provide Purah with {{Color BotW|Red|ancient components}}, she can use them to strengthen your runes.

The Sheikah Sensor takes {{Color BotW|Red|three ancient screws}}, Remote Bombs require {{Color BotW|Red|three ancient shafts}}, and Stasis needs {{Color BotW|Red|three ancient cores}}. |- | Complete | Purah powered up your Sheikah Sensor, Remote Bombs, and Stasis!

Purah claims that she's now pushed your runes as far as they can go. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Hateno Ancient Tech Lab * Purah * Side Quest }} {{Notes}} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
